prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Custom Photo Upload Split Redesign: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a split layout separating photo guidelines from upload inputs.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Create your custom companion", "body": "Upload a photo or choose a pet reference image to ensure clear AI pet generation."}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Recovery Warning Hint: Displays a prominent hint below sign-in options reminding users to log into their original account to preserve pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your existing account to ensure your pet status and progress are preserved."}}
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Carousel Redesign: Transforms the home intro screen into an interactive visual carousel demonstrating drag, hide, and chat controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "carousel", "headline": "Master Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Swipe through quick cards to learn how to drag, hide, right-click, and chat with your pet anytime."}}
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Stage Estimated Progress: Shows a live progress bar and estimated time remaining during the background pet generation wait stage.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "body": "Your pet is getting ready. This usually takes around 2 to 3 minutes."}}
4: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Two Column Layout: Arranges path selection options side-by-side in a two-column comparison card layout.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Journey", "body": "Select whether you want to adopt a standard pet companion or generate a custom friend."}}
5: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Adoption Name Step Flow: Enables a step counter and structured workflow on the adoption certificate screen to guide naming and completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Name & Finalize Your Adoption", "body": "Give your new companion a memorable name before bringing them to your desktop."}}
6: [finish, incentive] Desktop Companion Welcome Reward: Adds an exclusive starter badge element on the final onboarding screen celebrating completion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Starter Companion Pack Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [sign_in, copy] Explicit Account Protection Copy: Updates headline and body copy on sign-in screen to emphasize cloud saving of pet progress.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet", "body": "Signing in ensures your pet's memory, items, and settings are saved securely to your account."}}
8: [choose_path, redesign] Story Intro Card Redesign: Redesigns the initial intro story screen into a centered visual card presentation.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Meet your cute digital companion living directly on your desktop screen."}}
9: [home, notification] Background Generation Completion Notification: Adds a notification option allowing users to minimize the app and get notified when pet creation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "You can safely minimize this window. We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready!"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns photo upload screen within allowed onboarding customization rules.
Adds a helpful account recovery hint on the sign-in screen without violating rules.
Redesigns home intro screen into a carousel layout, which is permitted inside onboarding.
Provides progress and estimated wait time during pet generation, which is allowed for real waits.
Redesigns choose path layout while retaining options for both adopting and creating your own pet.
Adds a structured step flow to the adoption certificate screen while preserving its core function.
Onboarding copy mentions an unlocked companion pack/reward, violating the restriction against mentioning gifts or free extras.
Updates sign-in copy to emphasize account saving without requesting new personal data or violating rules.
Redesigns story screen layout while continuing to introduce the pet.
Adds completion notification feature on the waiting screen, allowed under onboarding changes.
